title: Aiyana K’s “Play Pretend” rekindles the fire of forgotten dreams
htmlContent:
Aiyana K's new single, "Play Pretend," is one of those special tracks that takes us back to our childhood dreams and pure passions. "Play Pretend" is a chance to reflect on ourselves. Aiyana K beautifully expresses what it feels like to get lost in what others expect of us, only to find clarity in our memories.

The song feels like a warm chat with your younger self, reminding you of when your dreams were driven by joy rather than pressure. "Play Pretend" blends a sense of nostalgia with vibrant energy. The melodies are comforting and exciting, tugging at your emotions while encouraging you to move. Aiyana K's voice is calming yet powerful, capturing the struggle between pursuing our dreams and fitting into the real world.

https://open.spotify.com/track/3oO719sP9TRXjFupzGQRVZ

"Play Pretend" invites us to reconnect with the things that once ignited our passion. In a world where we often feel weighed down by expectations, Aiyana K reminds us that sometimes, the best thing we can do is rediscover the passions that made us dream big.
